info.title: WOA Personal Workout And Analytics API
info.description: Personal-key REST API for owned workouts and four owned analytics endpoints, reused by the hosted OAuth MCP server. Shared retrospective UTC yearly FTP/TSS policy, multi-year analytics within technical data/history/response budgets, fourfold request quotas and correlated safe diagnostics. See public-api-v1.md for semantics and rollout.

tags.name: Workouts
tags.description: Owned imported workouts only; no manual or group-shared entries.

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Owned training aggregates and recorded performance. Source workout IDs/offsets are returned only by power profile with additional workouts:read. No GPS, notes, devices or raw samples.

get.summary: List owned workouts and their scalar metrics
get.description: Only documented query parameters are accepted, once each. Start time DESC NULLS LAST, then numeric ID DESC. Time bounds apply to start time and exclude null start times. Repeat filters with the cursor. No total count or snapshot consistency is promised. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 start-time bound with UTC offset and at most six fractional digits. Must precede to when both are present.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive RFC 3339 start-time bound with UTC offset and at most six fractional digits.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Encrypted and authenticated opaque continuation bound to the user, filters and sort, including the null-start partition. Expires after 24 hours. Limit may change.

200.description: A page of owned workouts; next_cursor is null at the end.

get.summary: Get one owned workout and its scalar metrics
get.description: Same field set as the list. No location, binary stream, device or internal processing data. Foreign and unknown IDs both return 404. Query parameters are not accepted.

get.summary: Get an owned workout's reduced GPS route
get.description: Both scopes are mandatory, even for an empty route. Preserve track gaps and longitude/latitude ordering. Return geometry null if no usable line exists. No extra database coordinate fields or raw binary data. Reject query parameters. Budgets: 2 MiB stored blob, 4 MiB decompressed data, 100000 slots including gaps, 4 MiB GeoJSON and 2 seconds per worker. At most two workers per application process; excess concurrency returns 429. Exceeding a size or time budget returns 422, never silent truncation. Invalid data returns 503.

200.description: A GeoJSON Feature; geometry may be null for an owned workout without a usable route.

get.summary: Download one owned workout as FIT
get.description: Requires all three scopes even for a workout without GPS. Query parameters are rejected. Unknown and foreign IDs return 404. Ten requests per rolling minute per user, shared across keys, plus the common user/ingress limits. Worker budgets: 15 seconds, 512 MiB old-generation heap, two simultaneous FIT workers per application process. Sources are capped at 16 MiB stored/32 MiB decoded workout data and 4 MiB stored/8 MiB decoded GPS; up to 172800 workout records/GPS slots, 1000 segments, 50000 phases and 64 KiB device metadata. The final FIT is capped at 32 MiB. Budget failure returns 422, busy workers return 429, corrupt source/dependency errors return safe JSON 503. Missing/invalid GPS slots retain their positions and prevent interpolation across gaps.

200.description: Complete regenerated FIT activity using the shared export generator: measurement series, available GPS with retained gaps, laps and available device metadata. Not a byte-for-byte original upload.

get.description: Only from/to UTC dates are accepted once each. Scope analytics:read is sufficient; no workout IDs or GPS are returned. Imported non-motorsport workouts and all manual activity types contribute volume. TSS applies to classified imported cycling and manual cycling; manual estimates are distinguishable. UTC start-day attribution, full history, 42/7-day daily rounded recurrence, TSB=CTL-ATL after the day. Missing TSS is counted and contributes zero to the recurrence. No load is reported before the first known TSS. FTP uses the existing yearly function with UTC interpolation, positive values only, no backward extrapolation before the first year and last-value carry-forward. Retrospective yearly estimates may change with imported data. Forty analytics requests per rolling minute/user shared across all four endpoints, keys and MCP connections, plus shared 240/user and 480/IP limits. Multi-year date ranges are supported within the technical budgets. At most two active calculations/process; 50000 source rows, 20000 history days, 500 FTP rows, 1 MiB response and 5 seconds per SQL statement. Exceeding budgets returns 422 without truncation; SQL/dependency failures return safe 503.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive UTC start date. Defaults to 28 days before to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive UTC end date. Defaults to tomorrow UTC, including the partial current day. Cannot exceed tomorrow. Interval must be nonempty; multi-year ranges are supported within technical budgets.

200.description: Owned activity analytics; load includes full bounded history before from and rest days through to.

get.description: Owned classified cycling stored critical segments only, no manual modeled activity. Without grouping, existing UTC from/to defaults apply; multi-year ranges are supported within technical data and response budgets. At most 50000 scalar source efforts in ungrouped mode or returned winners in grouped mode, 1 MiB JSON, 5 seconds per SQL statement, two shared analytics calculations/process and shared analytics 40/minute/user limits. No stream decoding, new performance calculation or silent truncation. Distinct allowlisted durations only. Each selected duration returns one winner or null fields. Tie order: power descending, exact UTC start timestamp descending, exact BIGINT workout and segment IDs descending. W/kg uses the returned power and historical source-date weight, falling back to profile weight; missing weight yields null. Requires workouts:read because workout IDs and source offsets are returned; missing it does not consume the analytics bucket. Optional grouping returns chronological calendar periods, each containing all selected duration points, including nulls in empty periods. Weeks start Monday UTC. In grouped mode, omitted from uses the earliest valid matching stored effort before to; omitted to includes today. No matching history without from returns data=[] and meta.from=null. Winners are ranked in one SQL source query; weights are fetched once for distinct winner dates.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive UTC start date. Without grouping defaults to 28 days before to. With grouping defaults to the first valid matching stored effort before to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive UTC end date. Defaults to tomorrow UTC, including the partial current day. Cannot exceed tomorrow. Interval must be nonempty; multi-year ranges are supported within technical budgets.

schema.description: Comma-separated distinct supported seconds, no spaces; defaults to all 13 durations.

parameters.name: grouping
parameters.description: Optional UTC calendar grouping. Omit for the existing global power profile. Weeks start Monday. Each period includes every selected duration; missing records remain null.

get.description: Owned classified cycling stored critical segments only, no manual modeled activity. Existing UTC from/to defaults apply; multi-year ranges are supported within technical data and response budgets. At most 50000 scalar source efforts, 1 MiB JSON, 5 seconds per SQL statement, two shared analytics calculations/process and shared analytics 40/minute/user limits. No stream decoding, new performance calculation or silent truncation. UTC calendar grouping, default month. Per bucket, continuous p95 of positive recorded CP8 and CP15 efforts; existing log extrapolation to CP20 multiplied by 0.95. All inputs restricted to the requested date interval, so clipped buckets are marked partial. Empty buckets and missing/nonpositive estimates return null. No rolling-window FTP and no waveform or source IDs.

data.description: All requested calendar buckets, bounded by the 1 MiB JSON response budget checked during construction. No annual bucket-count cap.

PersonalApiKey.description: High-entropy user-issued key. HTTP Bearer security lists no OAuth scopes; x-required-scopes declares the additional application-level AND requirement. No cookies or query-string credentials.

WorkoutId.name: id
WorkoutId.description: Positive decimal PostgreSQL BIGINT represented as a string. Out-of-range IDs are invalid.

Allow.description: Only GET is supported on public API paths. HEAD, OPTIONS and writes return 405.

FitAttachment.description: Attachment filename derived from workout start in UTC; safe workout-ID fallback.

RequestId.description: Server-generated UUID for this request. Error bodies and sanitized public_api_error logs use the same ID. Client-provided IDs are ignored.

BadRequest.description: invalid_request: invalid or unexpected parameter, date range, ID or cursor.

Unauthorized.description: unauthorized: missing, invalid, expired or revoked key; do not reveal which credential check failed.

Forbidden.description: insufficient_scope or account_unavailable. Unknown account states fail closed.

NotFound.description: workout_not_found: absent and foreign workouts are indistinguishable.

GpsBudgetExceeded.description: gps_response_too_large: the complete route cannot be returned within the response budget. No truncated success response.

RateLimited.description: rate_limited: user or protective request allowance exceeded.

Unavailable.description: service_unavailable: an authentication or storage dependency is unavailable. Authorization is never bypassed.

FitBudgetExceeded.description: fit_response_too_large: source/record/lap/response/time/heap budget exceeded. Never returns a partial FIT file.

AnalyticsBudgetExceeded.description: Analytics source/history/FTP/response budget exceeded; no partial result.

Id.description: Positive decimal ID, additionally bounded by PostgreSQL signed BIGINT (9223372036854775807).

NullableMetric.description: Finite non-negative measurement; null means missing or not applicable. Units are explicit in the containing field name/documentation.

Workout.description: Allowlisted scalar summary, identical on list and detail. Derived metrics follow the documented historical FTP policy. No streams, location coordinates, device identifiers, model blobs or processing internals.

uploaded_at.description: Legacy timezone-less upload timestamp interpreted as UTC, as confirmed by the user, and normalized to UTC. No database-session or host timezone dependence.

tss.description: Estimated integer TSS using the unrounded retrospective UTC yearly FTP basis shared with analytics. Classified cycling only; missing prerequisites or a date before the first valid FTP anchor yields null. Valid zero remains zero.

ftp_used_watts.description: Unrounded UTC yearly FTP interpolation used for IF/TSS. Null before the first valid anchor; after the last anchor use its FTP. May change with FTP history.

items.description: Exactly longitude then latitude, bounded to [-180,180] and [-90,90] respectively; validate positions semantically.

message.description: Safe English explanation, not a stack trace or raw dependency error.

timer_time_seconds.description: Sum of known durations, or null if every activity duration is missing. Activities are assigned entirely to their UTC start day.

tss.description: Sum of known applicable TSS; null if all applicable TSS are missing, zero for a rest day or no applicable activities. Inspect missing_tss_count for partial sums.

recorded_derived_tss.description: Known TSS derived from imported cycling NP, duration and yearly interpolated FTP; not directly measured TSS.

manual_estimated_tss.description: Known TSS from manually entered estimates or modeled manual cycling power; never a measured performance record.

history_from.description: First included day with known applicable TSS, or null if none. CTL/ATL start from zero on this day.

history_missing_tss_count.description: Applicable activities with missing TSS anywhere before to, including the history before from. Missing contributions use zero for CTL/ATL, so load is incomplete if this is nonzero.

confidence.description: Minimum of the positive CP8/CP15 stored effort counts, matching the existing method. Not a probability or confidence percentage.

from.description: First matching valid effort date when from is omitted; null only when no history matches and data is empty.

period_from.description: Inclusive full UTC calendar period start.

period_to.description: Exclusive full UTC calendar period end.

partial_period.description: Period crosses the requested bounds or is not complete at generated_at.

data.description: Chronological periods including empty periods; empty if no matching history and from omitted. Bounded by response byte budget.
